notes: The bench judge's expected-verdict roster (tools/benchjudge --roster): membership by cell name, the board-side sibling of the gate's expected-failure test roster. Every cell is judged at the ceiling its bench sidecar declares (general 1.3, text 1.7; tools/benchjudge states both derivations) — this file carries expectations only and can never select a ceiling. `red` cells must be judged and read red at their own ceiling; the set is exactly the permanent schoolbook display tripwire (`display_schoolbook/hugeleaf`, a text-ceiling cell timing the known-quadratic conversion class kept in bench code — green means the judge's time leg went dark). Every other cell, the pinned subset's designed diagonal and the BOARD_DECLARED_BENCH_RIDERS alike, must fit under its own ceiling: the board's declared-model cells (the tick trio's and min_ticks' certificate/reign heap constants, the mirror-wide display pair's limb model) keep their time legs judged green — a declared counter model is not a time-exponent red (the declared riders measured e 0.93–1.18 at their pinning) — and the hugeleaf display pair (`version_display/hugeleaf`, `clock_display/hugeleaf`) is judged green at the text ceiling its sidecar declares: conversion-dominated rendering, the declared render model at the sidecar's TEXT_CEILING_CELLS pin (measured e 1.39/1.42 under the 1.7 ceiling, quick sampling). The sampling pin lists both modes because these are exponent-class expectations, which hold under quick and record sampling alike (record-mode wide-pair exponents measured 1.464/2.001); the profile and the scale pair stay singly pinned. Membership is pinned by crates/before/tests/bench_judge_roster.rs. Rostered reds are re-attested at `just all` cadence, where the bench-judge recipes run with the machine to themselves; the gate's parallel tier judges no wall time.
